name: paopao
description: Paopao local-first desktop capture and living library

scripts.typecheck: npm run check --workspace=paopao-desktop && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:evals
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --workspace=@paopao/domain && npm run test --workspace=paopao-desktop --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run rebuild:native:node && npm run test --workspace=@paopao/infrastructure && npm run test:integration --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:g3
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@paopao/domain && npm run build --workspace=@paopao/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@paopao/core && npm run build --workspace=@paopao/infrastructure && npm run build --workspace=@paopao/feishu-adapter && npm run build --workspace=paopao-desktop
scripts.smoke:preload: npm run build:electron --workspace=paopao-desktop && npm run smoke:preload:runtime
